diagnosis: Malignant FNAB axillary node – metastatic carcinoma
legend: A cohesive crowded tissue fragment of large epithelial cells with atypical nuclei is present in a lymphoid background. (Giemsa)

The smear shows both a fragment of malignant epithelial cells, at the left of the image, and contrasting germinal centre material, at the right of the image, with a background of mixed lymphoid cells. The features are consistent with carcinoma of no special type metastatic to a lymph node (Giemsa).

diagnosis: Metastatic lobular carcinoma to lymph node
legend: Small tissue fragments of lobular carcinoma are present showing mild to moderate nuclear atypia and an intracytoplasmic vacuole in the centre of the image. The “small cells” of lobular carcinoma are larger than the lymphocytes. (Giemsa)
A tissue fragment of atypical epithelial cells in a lymphoid background, consistent with metastasis from a carcinoma of no special type (NST). (Pap)
